Here is the complete picture:

**AuthController** (`application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/AuthController.java`) directly depends on **6 service interfaces**, each with one concrete implementation:

---

| Service Interface | Implementation Class |
|---|---|
| `UserService` | `UserServiceImpl` |
| `SystemSecurityService` | `DefaultSystemSecurityService` |
| `MailService` | `DefaultMailService` |
| `TwoFactorAuthService` | `DefaultTwoFactorAuthService` |
| `SecuritySettingsService` | `DefaultSecuritySettingsService` |
| `RateLimitService` | `DefaultRateLimitService` |

> Note: `JwtTokenFactory` is a concrete `@Component` class (not an interface), so it has no separate implementation.

---
